# Now 2.11.0
- New full-screen Now Playing view: a large, immersive display of album art, track info, and auto-scrolling synchronized lyrics — with a clean art-and-info layout when a song has no lyrics. - Open it from the menu bar ("Full Screen Lyrics"), the ⌘⇧F shortcut, or the expand button on the overlay. Close it with the ✕ or the Escape key; the desktop overlay keeps working exactly as before. - Playback controls (previous, play/pause, next) and volume work from the full-screen view; the progress bar reflects playback position.

# Now 2.10.81
- Fixed instrumental tracks showing a stray Chinese line ("pure music, please enjoy") instead of no lyrics. NetEase and QQ Music return that placeholder for songs with no words; Now now recognizes it and falls back to the title/artist view. - The lyrics cache is refreshed on this update so any instrumental that already cached that placeholder is cleared automatically.

# Now 2.10.80
- Cleaned up lyrics from NetEase and QQ Music: leading and trailing production credits (composer, lyricist, mixing/mastering, and the "Title - Artist" header) are now trimmed, so the overlay shows the actual song from the first sung line. - Credit trimming only touches the start and end of the lyric and only for those two sources, so real lyrics — and LRCLIB / Apple Music lyrics — are never altered.
